er_expectation_mismatch.definition: The gap between what two people in a relationship each expect, when neither has said it aloud.
er_expectation_mismatch.example: The expectation mismatch was about phone calls, and it had been there for months.

favourite.definition: The one you like most of all, the one you hope to see on the table.
favourite.example: My favourite food is spring rolls.

msa_choice_set.definition: The people who are actually available to you to choose from at a given time.
msa_choice_set.example: Your choice set is the people you actually meet, not everybody you like the idea of.

overdue_fee.definition: The charge the bank makes for a late payment, on top of any penalty rate and any loss of your good history.
overdue_fee.example: The late payment cost me a 35 $ overdue fee and my standard rate went up.

reliable_source.definition: A medical source written or reviewed by qualified professionals, updated, and not selling the fear it describes.
